content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Disputes ## slug: disputes ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## What is a Dispute? ### Introduction A {{variable.Object_Dispute}} is a situation in which a customer questions the validity of a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} that was registered to their account. If you are unfamiliar with how {{variable.Object_Dispute}}s are received, the associated fees, or what to submit, please review [Stripe's documentation](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes){target="_blank"}. ### Setup Create a [webhook](/v1/docs/webhooks) between {{variable.Product_Stripe}} and {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. ### Testing Disputes In order to test {{variable.Object_Dispute}}s you will need to use a specific test credit card created for a [dispute simulation](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-test-stripe-payment-gateway#disputes){target=`_blank`}. ### Receiving a Dispute Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} object. * ***Lightning:** Navigate to app launcher > Under "All Items" select Dispute.* * ***Classic:** Click "All Tabs" (The "+" icon in the top right corner) > select Dispute.* * A {{variable.Object_Dispute}} record is created through [Webhook Events](/v1/docs/webhook-events) with the {{variable.Field_WebhookEvent_Status}} = {{variable.Picklist_WebhookStat_NeedsResp}}. * The disputed {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} changes from {{variable.Picklist_TransPayStatus_Captur}} to {{variable.Picklist_TransPayStatus_Disput}} and a refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is created for the captured amount. The {{variable.Product_Stripe}} fee for the dispute will also be populated on the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayGatewaFee}} field on the refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. ![H_01_05_Dispute 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_05_Dispute%201.png){height="" width=""} *Disputed Transaction* * * * ![H_01_05_Dispute 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_05_Dispute%202.png){height="" width=""} :::(Info) () If you notice that two refund Transactions are created when you receive a Dispute, this is because the old dispute logic operated in this manner. Please upgrade to the latest Payments package to see the most recent dispute logic. ::: - When receiving a {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, you have until the {{variable.Field_Dispute_DueBy}} date to formally respond and submit all supporting evidence. - The {{variable.Object_Dispute}} {{variable.Field_Dispute_Reason}} is what the cardholder defined the disputed payment as. *[Dispute reasons](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes/categories)* - The {{variable.Field_Dispute_Refundable}}, {{variable.Field_Dispute_HasEvidence}}, and {{variable.Field_Dispute_PastDue}} fields track where the disputed record is in the process.*These fields can be used as notification filters in a Workflow, Process Builder, or Reports to make sure {{variable.Object_Dispute}}s are submitted before being past due.* - After adding your {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} and clicking **Submit**, the {{variable.Field_Dispute_SubmissionCount}} = "1" and the {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} = "Under Review". *It has now been submitted to [Stripe's financial partner](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes#how-evidence-submission-works) for review and no changes can be made.* - If you won the {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} will update to "Won". If the card issuer won the {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} will update to "Lost". *Once a Dispute has been "Won" or "Lost", Stripe will send out an email with the Dispute information.* **Notes** - **Important note from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}:** If you receive a {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, try contacting your customer and discuss it before you respond. It’s possible that they simply did not recognize or remember the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} when they viewed their statement. - {{variable.Product_Stripe}} will charge you a [$15.00 Dispute fee](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes#fees) (for users in the United States) by the card network. If you win the {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, the original amount will be refunded to you and a $15.00 adjustment {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will be created for you to cover the original {{variable.Product_Stripe}} fee. - ACH disputes cannot be contested. If you receive an [ACH dispute](https://support.stripe.com/questions/accepting-ach-payments-with-stripe#ach-disputes) the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} = "Lost" and the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Refunded". ## Dispute Evidence The purpose of the {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} object is to submit evidence in defense of your {{variable.Object_Dispute}} that will push to {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. Review all evidence before clicking **Submit**, as you cannot update evidence once submitted. There are four different {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_RecordType}}s for {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}}. {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_RecordType}}s are used because not all fields are relevant for all {{variable.Object_Dispute}} types (as is designed in the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} dashboard), however, if you do need access to other fields as part of the {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, you can add them to the Page Layout or update the same data set in the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} dashboard: * Basic Response * Physical Product * Digital Product or Service * Offline Service ![H_01_05_Dispute Evidence 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_05_Dispute%20Evidence%201.png){height="" width=""} ### Creating a New Dispute Evidence Record ![Creating a Dispute Evidence Record](https://youtu.be/9l6thnrpjmU){height="480" width="640"} 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} object. *Lightning/Classic: Navigate to the Dispute record > under Related Lists, click **New** for Dispute Evidence.* 2. Select a {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_RecordType}} and click **Next**. 3. {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Prod_ProdDescr}}, {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Prod_CustName}}, {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Prod_CustEmail}}, {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Prod_BillAddre}}, and {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Prod_CustIPAdd}} are general fields for all Product Categories and should be filled out unless they are not applicable. 4. Stripe Data fields will populate automatically once the {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} has been submitted. **Note** Enter as much information as you can into all sections of the {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} record. {{variable.Product_Stripe}} provides best practice recommendations for preparing suitable responses. Click [here](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes#what-to-submit){target="_blank"}. ### Upload Documentation Documentation can be uploaded through the **Upload Files** button under the {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. ![Uploading Dispute Evidence Documentation](https://youtu.be/FaFgpLU2Ldc){height="480" width="640"} 1. Click **Upload Files**. 2. Upload all relevant documentation. 3. Click the "Title" link of all uploaded file(s). 4. Click **Go To Content Page** (Classic UI - located in the top right of the page) or click **Edit File Details** (Lightning UI - pencil icon in the top right of the page). *Can't find the Go To Content Page link? You might not have "Salesforce CRM Content User" enabled on your user record.* ![H_01_05_Dispute Evidence 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_05_Dispute%20Evidence%202.png){height="" width=""} 5. Under Content Details, click edit, and select **Edit Content Details** (Classic UI). 6. Click {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Type}} and select the available type for your uploaded documentation.*Can't see the {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Type}} field in Lightning? Edit the Content Version Page Layout to include the {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Type}} field.* 7. Click **Save**. *Perform this process for each uploaded file.* **Notes** * There is no limit to the number of files you can upload. * Upload documents per {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Type}}, do not combine all documents into one file upload. * Evidence cannot be added to Lost Disputes. 8. When you have uploaded and defined the {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Type}} of your documentation you are ready to submit your evidence. ### Submit Dispute Evidence ![Submitting Dispute Evidence](https://youtu.be/dkqpVTF71Zo){height="480" width="640"} 1. Navigate to your {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} record. 2. Click the **Submit** button. *Once you click the **Submit** button, you can no longer edit, delete, or add anything to the record.* What happens when you submit evidence? - Evidence is submitted to {{variable.Product_Stripe}}'s financial partner. - No one can edit, delete, or add anything to the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} record. - {{variable.Object_Dispute}} {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} = "Under Review". - {{variable.Object_Dispute}} {{variable.Field_Dispute_SubmissionCount}} = "1". - {{variable.Object_Dispute}} {{variable.Field_Dispute_HasEvidence}} = "TRUE". Then you wait...50-75 days for a response :) Submitting Evidence in Stripe: If you submit evidence in the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} Dashboard (as opposed to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}), all evidence information will get created in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} as [Webhook Events](/v1/docs/webhook-event). - The {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} record will relate to the open {{variable.Object_Dispute}}. - {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_FileID}} fields will populate with a Stripe Id if a document was uploaded for that particular {{variable.Field_DispuEvid_Type}}. ![H_01_05_Dispute Evidence 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_05_Dispute%20Evidence%203.png){height="" width=""} **NOTE:** Learn more about [evidence submission](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes#how-evidence-submission-works){target="_blank"}. ## Accept, Withdraw, and Refund Disputes ### Accept Closing the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} for a charge indicates that you do not have any evidence to submit and are dismissing the {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, or acknowledging it as lost. The disputed amount and $15 fee will not be reimbursed. Steps to Accept a Dispute: 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} record. 2. Click **Accept Dispute** button. 3. The {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} will be updated to "Lost". Losing a {{variable.Object_Dispute}} will update the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} to "Refunded". ### Withdrawn If your customer has created a {{variable.Object_Dispute}} in error and plans to withdraw it, you will need to submit proof in {{variable.Object_DisputeEvidence}} that the customer made a mistake. When a {{variable.Object_Dispute}} is withdrawn: * The {{variable.Object_Dispute}} {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} = "Won". * The original {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} will be refunded to you. * An adjustment {{variable.Object_Transaction}} for $15.00 will be created. This is {{variable.Product_Stripe}} reimbursing you for the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} fee. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} on the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will update to {{variable.Picklist_TransPayStatus_Captur}}. ### Refund If you are refunding a customer that has withdrawn their {{variable.Object_Dispute}}, it can take up to 75 days to refund the payment because the disputed claim must close first. *Trying to refund a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} before the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} is closed will result in a failed {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.* Steps for refunding a withdrawn {{variable.Object_Dispute}}: 1. Once the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} {{variable.Field_Dispute_Status}} = "Won", navigate back to the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 2. Click **Refund** at the top of the page (Classic UI) or click the drop-down arrow and select "Refund" (Lightning UI). Additional information on [refunding a withdrawn Dispute](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes#refunding-a-withdrawn-dispute){target="_blank"}. ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with {{variable.Object_Dispute}}s or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-troubleshooting){target=`_blank`} or [FAQ](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-faq){target=`_blank`} page.
